tools.name: relay_map
tools.title: Open Relay Map dashboard
tools.description: Open the interactive Relay Map pew-pew dashboard showing live Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, opencode, and pi sessions, message arcs, health alerts, token burn, and broadcast controls.

tools.name: relay_sessions
tools.title: List live agent sessions
tools.description: List live Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, opencode, and pi sessions on this computer or over ssh.

tools.name: relay_send
tools.title: Send relayed message
tools.description: Send a relayed message to a live agent session on this computer or over ssh, optionally waiting for a reply.

tools.name: relay_inbox
tools.title: Inspect session inbox
tools.description: Inspect pending relayed messages in a local Claude Code or pi session mailbox.

tools.name: relay_read_reply
tools.title: Read recent agent replies
tools.description: Read recent assistant replies from a Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, opencode, or pi session.

tools.name: relay_broadcast
tools.title: Broadcast to agents
tools.description: Preview or send a broadcast message to all live agents, a pool, or selected agents through agent-relay.

tools.name: relay_transcript
tools.title: Read session transcript
tools.description: Read an agent session's recorded transcript (flattened turns or raw JSONL tail) from the collector's recorded transcript path.
